쪽.x: You can go this way to get to the station.
쪽.e: Builds 오른쪽 (right) and 왼쪽 (left). Also means 'page'.
쪽.t: Combines with 이/그/저/어느: 이쪽, 그쪽, 저쪽, 어느 쪽. 이쪽 also politely means 'this person'.

벽.x: I hung a family photo on the living room wall.

작년.x: I came to Korea for the first time last year.

비슷하다.m: to be similar, to be alike
비슷하다.x: The two of them have very similar personalities.

거짓말하다.forms: 거짓말해요 · 거짓말했어요 · 거짓말할 거예요 · 거짓말하지 마세요
거짓말하다.m: to lie, to tell a lie
거짓말하다.ex: 아무리 힘들어도 친구에게 거짓말하면 안 돼요.
거짓말하다.x: No matter how hard it is, you shouldn't lie to your friends.

삼계탕.x: On the hottest days of summer, we go out for samgyetang.
삼계탕.e: Literally 'ginseng chicken soup': a whole young chicken stuffed with rice, ginseng and jujube.
삼계탕.t: Eaten on 복날 (초복, 중복, 말복), three 'dog days' spread over the hottest stretch of summer, to beat the heat with heat (이열치열).

생산.x: Rice production rose sharply this year.
생산.e: Literally 'bring to life and give birth'.

국가.x: The state must protect the safety of its people.
국가.e: Literally 'country-house': the nation as one family. Homonym 국가 means national anthem.
국가.t: Pronounced [국까]. 국가 is formal; in everyday speech 나라 is more common.

즉시.forms: 즉시 + action: 즉시 연락하다, 즉시 출발하다
즉시.ex: 문제가 생기면 즉시 저에게 연락해 주세요.
즉시.x: If a problem comes up, please contact me immediately.

장치.ex: 이 건물에는 안전 장치가 잘 되어 있어요.
장치.x: This building is well equipped with safety devices.

대표적.ex: 김치는 한국의 가장 대표적인 음식 중 하나예요.
대표적.x: Kimchi is one of Korea's most representative foods.

접수하다.m: to register, to check in; to receive (an application)
접수하다.x: When you get to the hospital, check in first and wait.
접수하다.t: Technically the office 접수하다 'receives'; patients and applicants use it too, meaning 'sign in, submit'.

삭제하다.x: I deleted an important photo by mistake.
삭제하다.t: Pronounced [삭쩨하다]; in casual speech 지우다 is just as common.

생산자.x: It's a market where producers and consumers meet directly.
생산자.e: -자 = person who does it: 생산자, 소비자, 투자자.

비교적.e: -적 = '-ic/-al', turning nouns into descriptors: 비교적, 경제적, 문화적.

마음을 먹다.m: to make up one's mind, to decide, to resolve
마음을 먹다.ex: 올해는 꼭 담배를 끊기로 마음을 먹었어요.
마음을 먹다.x: I've made up my mind to quit smoking this year.
마음을 먹다.e: 먹다 here means 'to take on' a feeling or resolve, as in 겁을 먹다 'to get scared.'
마음을 먹다.t: Usually V-기로 마음(을) 먹다, and it's often written as one word, 마음먹다.

중계.ex: 오늘 밤 축구 경기는 생중계로 방송됩니다.
중계.x: Tonight's soccer game will be broadcast live.

인도적.ex: 정부는 난민에게 인도적 지원을 계속하기로 했습니다.
인도적.x: The government decided to continue humanitarian aid to refugees.
인도적.e: 인도 'the way of humanity' + -적 '-al'. Not related to 인도 'India' or 'sidewalk'.

숙연하다.x: When the moment of silence began, the mood became solemn.
숙연하다.t: Usually describes a mood or people becoming solemn: 숙연해지다.

중도.ex: 그 후보는 중도 성향의 유권자들에게 인기가 많아요.
중도.x: That candidate is popular with centrist voters.
중도.e: Literally 'the middle way'. Homonym 중도 (a different hanja) means 'halfway', as in 중도에 포기하다.

공단.ex: 이 근처 공단에는 자동차 부품 공장이 많아요.
공단.x: There are many auto parts factories in the industrial complex near here.
공단.t: Homonym warning: 공단 (公團) also means a public corporation, as in 국민건강보험공단.

선행 학습.ex: 많은 부모가 아이들에게 선행 학습을 시켜요.
선행 학습.x: Many parents make their kids study material ahead of their grade.
선행 학습.e: Literally 'going-ahead learning' — studying next year's material early, often at cram schools.
선행 학습.t: 학습 is pronounced [학씁]; don't mix up 선행 'going ahead' with 선행 'good deed.'

중진.m: leading figure, senior member, heavyweight (of a party or field)
중진.ex: 당의 중진 의원들이 긴급 회의에 참석했습니다.
중진.x: The party's senior lawmakers attended an emergency meeting.
중진.e: Literally 'heavy anchor' — someone who holds a group steady.

덕질.ex: 요즘 아이돌 덕질하는 게 제 유일한 낙이에요.
덕질.x: These days, being an idol fan is my only joy.
덕질.e: 덕(후) 'otaku, superfan' (from Japanese otaku via 오덕후) + -질 'doing'.
덕질.t: Casual. Pronounced [덕찔]. 덕질하다 = to be into something as a fan; a superfan is a 덕후.

목이 잘리다.forms: 목이 잘렸어요 · 목이 잘릴 뻔했어요 · 목이 잘리면
목이 잘리다.m: to get fired, to get the axe (lit. to have one's neck cut)
목이 잘리다.ex: 실수를 크게 해서 회사에서 목이 잘릴 뻔했어요.
목이 잘리다.x: I made a big mistake and almost got fired.
목이 잘리다.e: Losing your job is pictured as losing your head.
목이 잘리다.t: Casual; often shortened to just 잘리다 (회사에서 잘렸어요). Neutral or formal: 해고되다.

재정정책.ex: 정부는 확장적 재정정책으로 일자리를 늘리려고 합니다.
재정정책.x: The government plans to create jobs through expansionary fiscal policy.
재정정책.e: Literally 'public-finance policy': decisions about taxes and government spending.

당파.x: During the Joseon dynasty, factional fighting was fierce.
당파.e: Literally 'party branch'; recalls the famous factional feuds of the Joseon court.

상호주의.ex: 정부는 상호주의 원칙에 따라 비자 정책을 바꿨습니다.
상호주의.x: The government changed its visa policy according to the principle of reciprocity.
상호주의.t: 주의 is pronounced [주이] in natural speech.

액화.ex: 액화 천연가스는 큰 배로 다른 나라에 운반합니다.
액화.x: Liquefied natural gas is shipped to other countries on large vessels.
액화.t: Pronounced [애콰] — ㄱ and ㅎ merge into ㅋ (aspiration).

초고속.ex: 한국은 초고속 인터넷이 일찍 보급된 나라입니다.
초고속.x: Korea is a country where high-speed internet spread early.
초고속.t: Mostly used before another noun: 초고속 인터넷, 초고속 열차, 초고속 성장.

낭만주의.ex: 낭만주의 시인들은 자연과 감정을 중요하게 여겼습니다.
낭만주의.x: Romantic poets valued nature and emotion.
낭만주의.e: 낭만 came via Japanese, whose characters were chosen for the sound 'roman,' not their meaning.
낭만주의.t: 낭만적이다 'to be romantic' is everyday Korean, e.g. a romantic evening.

단식농성.ex: 그 의원은 법안 통과를 요구하며 단식농성에 들어갔습니다.
단식농성.x: The lawmaker began a hunger strike demanding the bill be passed.
단식농성.e: Literally 'cut off food and hold the fort'.
단식농성.t: Pronounced [단싱농성]: ㄱ before ㄴ becomes ㅇ (nasalization).
